name: Dynamic equilibrium
subject: Chemistry
description: At equilibrium, forward and reverse reaction rates are equal. Reactions continue and concentrations stay constant.

name: Law of mass action
subject: Chemistry
description: In the equilibrium expression, each concentration is raised to its stoichiometric coefficient. Pure solids and liquids have unit activity.

name: Equilibrium constant Kc
subject: Chemistry
description: Kc is the ratio of product to reactant concentration terms at equilibrium. Its value depends on temperature.

name: Kp and gaseous moles
subject: Chemistry
description: Kp = Kc(RT)^Δn, where Δn is gaseous product coefficients minus gaseous reactant coefficients.

name: Le Chatelier’s principle
subject: Chemistry
description: A system shifts to oppose a concentration, pressure or temperature change. A catalyst changes the rate of reaching equilibrium, not its position.

name: Standard quadratic form
subject: Mathematics
description: A quadratic has the form ax² + bx + c = 0, with a ≠ 0. Move every term to one side before identifying coefficients.

name: Factorisation
subject: Mathematics
description: Write the quadratic as a product equal to zero. At least one factor must be zero; solve both factors.

name: Discriminant
subject: Mathematics
description: D = b² − 4ac. D > 0 means two distinct real roots; D = 0 means equal real roots; D < 0 means no real roots.

name: Quadratic formula
subject: Mathematics
description: For ax² + bx + c = 0, x = (−b ± √(b² − 4ac))/(2a). Keep the entire numerator over 2a.

name: Word problems
subject: Mathematics
description: Define the variable, form a quadratic and check roots against the context. Lengths and counts must be valid.

name: Pure substances and mixtures
subject: Chemistry
description: A mixture contains substances in variable proportions; physical separation can often recover components.

name: Colloids and suspensions
subject: Chemistry
description: Colloidal particles scatter light, making the beam path visible under suitable conditions.

name: Atomic number and mass number
subject: Chemistry
description: Mass number is the number of protons plus neutrons: 11 + 12 = 23.

name: Valency and formulae
subject: Chemistry
description: Electrical neutrality requires two Al3+ ions and three O2- ions, giving Al2O3.

name: Distance and displacement
subject: Physics
description: Displacement depends on final and initial position. They are the same after a complete lap.

name: Acceleration
subject: Physics
description: Acceleration is change in velocity divided by time: (10 - 2)/4 = 2 m/s2.

name: Newton's laws
subject: Physics
description: Newton's second law gives net force F = ma = 3 x 2 = 6 N.

name: Mechanical advantage
subject: Physics
description: Mechanical advantage is load divided by effort: 120/30 = 4.

name: Diffusion and osmosis
subject: Biology
description: Osmosis involves water moving through a selectively permeable membrane down its water-potential gradient.

name: Epithelial and connective tissues
subject: Biology
description: Tendons connect muscles to bones. Ligaments connect bones to other bones.

name: Flowers and pollination
subject: Biology
description: Pollination transfers pollen. Fertilisation is fusion of gametes, which occurs later.

name: Binomial nomenclature
subject: Biology
description: A binomial consists of a genus name followed by a specific epithet.

name: Rational and irrational numbers
subject: Mathematics
description: The square root of 2 cannot be expressed as a ratio of integers; the other listed numbers are rational.

name: Arithmetic progressions
subject: Mathematics
description: This arithmetic progression has common difference 3. The next term is 13 + 3 = 16.

name: Degree and coefficients
subject: Mathematics
description: The degree is the greatest exponent of x with a nonzero coefficient, here 3.

name: Linear pairs
subject: Mathematics
description: A linear pair sums to 180 degrees, so the second angle is 180 - 65 = 115 degrees.

name: Plate tectonics
subject: Social Science
description: Plate tectonics describes movement and interaction of lithospheric plates over geological time.

name: Neolithic settlements
subject: Social Science
description: Neolithic changes included cultivation and domestication, encouraging more settled communities in many regions.

name: Features and types
subject: Social Science
description: Democracy requires meaningful participation and institutions through which rulers can be held accountable.

name: Opportunity cost
subject: Social Science
description: Choosing one option sacrifices the next-best feasible alternative; its value is the opportunity cost.

name: Balancing equations
subject: Chemistry
description: Balancing conserves the number of atoms of each element and reflects conservation of mass.

name: Neutralisation
subject: Chemistry
description: Neutralisation is an acid-base reaction producing salt and, in common school examples, water.

name: Reactivity series
subject: Chemistry
description: Zinc is more reactive than copper and can displace it from copper sulfate solution.

name: Homologous series
subject: Chemistry
description: A homologous series shares a functional group and general formula; successive members typically differ by CH2.

name: Lens power
subject: Physics
description: Power is 1/f with f in metres: 1/0.5 = +2 dioptres.

name: Vision defects
subject: Physics
description: A concave lens diverges incoming rays so a myopic eye can focus distant objects on the retina.

name: Resistance and Ohm's law
subject: Physics
description: Ohm's law gives R = V/I = 6/2 = 3 ohms, at constant physical conditions.

name: Safety
subject: Physics
description: A series fuse in the live wire breaks the circuit when excessive current melts its element.

name: Transport
subject: Biology
description: Xylem carries water and mineral ions; phloem transports organic food between sources and sinks.

name: Neurons and reflexes
subject: Biology
description: Reflex pathways allow rapid involuntary responses to stimuli through neural circuits.

name: Mendelian patterns
subject: Biology
description: The genotypes are AA, Aa, Aa and aa. Under complete dominance, three show the dominant phenotype.

name: Trophic levels
subject: Biology
description: The ten-percent model approximates energy transfer between trophic levels; most energy is not transferred onward as biomass.

name: nth term
subject: Mathematics
description: The nth term is a + (n - 1)d. Here it is 3 + 9 x 2 = 21.

name: Distance formula
subject: Mathematics
description: The distance formula gives sqrt(3 squared + 4 squared) = sqrt(25) = 5.

name: Standard angles
subject: Mathematics
description: Sine is the ratio of the opposite side to the hypotenuse for an acute angle in a right triangle.

name: Simple probability
subject: Mathematics
description: There are three even outcomes among six equally likely outcomes, so the probability is 3/6 = 1/2.

name: Civil disobedience
subject: Social Science
description: Gandhi's Salt March challenged the salt law and became a major event in the Civil Disobedience Movement.

name: Division of powers
subject: Social Science
description: Federal arrangements divide powers between levels of government under constitutional rules.

name: Primary secondary and tertiary
subject: Social Science
description: Manufacturing transforms raw materials into other goods, a defining activity of the secondary sector.

name: Formal and informal credit
subject: Social Science
description: Formal banking operates under legal and regulatory frameworks; terms still need to be examined by borrowers.

name: Mole concept
subject: Chemistry
description: Number of moles is mass divided by molar mass: 18/18 = 1 mol.

name: Ionisation enthalpy
subject: Chemistry
description: Effective nuclear attraction generally increases across a period, though subshell and pairing effects create exceptions.

name: First law
subject: Chemistry
description: With w defined as work done on the system, internal-energy change equals heat supplied plus work done on it.

name: Oxidation numbers
subject: Chemistry
description: Four oxygens contribute -8. The ion totals -2, so sulfur must contribute +6.

name: Dimensions
subject: Physics
description: From F = ma, force has dimensions mass times length divided by time squared.

name: Projectile motion
subject: Physics
description: With gravity as the only force, acceleration acts vertically; horizontal acceleration is zero.

name: Escape speed
subject: Physics
description: Neglecting atmosphere and rotation, escape speed is sqrt(2GM/R), independent of the escaping object's mass.

name: Thermal equilibrium
subject: Physics
description: The zeroth law expresses the transitive nature of thermal equilibrium and underlies temperature measurement.

name: Cell organelles
subject: Biology
description: Mitochondria contain the machinery for key stages of aerobic respiration and oxidative phosphorylation.

name: Calvin cycle
subject: Biology
description: RuBisCO catalyses carboxylation of RuBP in the Calvin cycle, initiating carbon assimilation.

name: Double circulation
subject: Biology
description: Pulmonary and systemic circuits bring blood through the heart twice in one complete circulation.

name: Meiosis
subject: Biology
description: Meiosis reduces chromosome number, supporting sexual reproduction and restoration of the diploid number at fertilisation.

name: Cartesian products
subject: Mathematics
description: The Cartesian product contains one ordered pair for each choice from A and B: 3 x 2 = 6.

name: Combinations
subject: Mathematics
description: Order does not matter, so use combinations: 5C2 = 5 x 4 / 2 = 10.

name: Derivative as rate
subject: Mathematics
description: The power rule gives d(x to the n)/dx = n x to the n - 1, so d(x squared)/dx = 2x.

name: Standard deviation
subject: Mathematics
description: Variance measures mean squared deviation. Standard deviation is its nonnegative square root and has the data's units.

name: Writing
subject: Social Science
description: Written records supported accounting, administration and communication in complex urban societies.

name: Fundamental rights
subject: Social Science
description: Constitutional recognition and judicial remedies provide mechanisms for protecting Fundamental Rights.

name: Production possibility frontier
subject: Social Science
description: A PPF represents feasible production trade-offs under specified resource and technology assumptions.

name: Seismic waves
subject: Social Science
description: Seismic S-waves require shear rigidity and do not propagate through liquids; this helps infer Earth's internal structure.

name: Van't Hoff factor
subject: Chemistry
description: Dissociation increases the effective number of solute particles, giving i greater than one in the idealised treatment.

name: Nernst equation
subject: Chemistry
description: The relation Delta G = -nFEcell means positive cell potential corresponds to negative Gibbs-energy change.

name: Half-life
subject: Chemistry
description: For a first-order process, t1/2 = ln(2)/k, so it does not depend on initial concentration.

name: Ligands and coordination number
subject: Chemistry
description: Denticity counts donor atoms from one ligand attached to a metal centre. Two donor atoms make it bidentate.

name: Gauss's law
subject: Physics
description: Total electric flux through a closed surface equals enclosed net charge divided by vacuum permittivity.

name: Kirchhoff's rules
subject: Physics
description: At a junction without charge accumulation, total current entering equals total current leaving.

name: Lenz's law
subject: Physics
description: The induced response opposes the flux change, consistent with energy conservation; it does not always oppose the existing field.

name: de Broglie waves
subject: Physics
description: The de Broglie relation is lambda = h/p, linking wavelength with particle momentum.

name: Double fertilisation
subject: Biology
description: One male gamete fuses with the egg; the other fuses with the central-cell nuclei in the usual angiosperm description.

name: Transcription
subject: Biology
description: Transcription synthesises RNA using a DNA template, with base-pairing and enzyme-controlled polymerisation.

name: PCR
subject: Biology
description: Polymerase chain reaction repeatedly copies a target DNA segment through controlled temperature cycles and suitable enzymes.

name: Energy flow
subject: Biology
description: Energy enters, is transferred and dissipates as heat; unlike matter, it is not recycled as a closed ecological energy loop.

name: Operations
subject: Mathematics
description: The inner dimensions must match; the product has the outer dimensions, 2 by 4.

name: Chain rule
subject: Mathematics
description: The derivative of a composite multiplies the outer derivative evaluated at the inner function by the inner derivative.

name: Antiderivatives
subject: Mathematics
description: Differentiating x squared plus a constant gives 2x. The constant represents the family of antiderivatives.

name: Bayes's theorem
subject: Mathematics
description: Bayes's theorem relates conditional probabilities using prior probabilities and the likelihood of evidence.

name: Constituent Assembly
subject: Social Science
description: The Constituent Assembly debated and adopted the Constitution, drawing on diverse ideas and negotiations.

name: Central bank
subject: Social Science
description: Central banks use monetary instruments to influence liquidity, credit and broader monetary conditions.

name: Real and nominal GDP
subject: Social Science
description: Real GDP values output at constant prices to separate changes in production from changes in prices.

name: Non-traditional security
subject: Social Science
description: Non-traditional security includes threats to people and societies such as epidemics, environmental risks and deprivation.
